'''Detention Block AA-23''' was a brig located within Detention Block AA on the [[Deck 5|fifth level]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]].

==History==
Just prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Cell 2187/Legends|Cell 2187]] was used for the interrogation and detainment of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]. It was located 400 meters (1,300 feet) below [[Docking Bay 327/Legends|Docking Bay 327]].

[[File:2187-ANH.png|thumb|left|250px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] interrogates [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] in [[Cell 2187/Legends|Cell 2187]] of Block AA-23.]]
After the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] was captured by the Death Star, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] discovered that the Princess was scheduled to be executed. Skywalker [[Rescue of Princess Leia/Legends|embarked]] on a mission to save the Princess after enlisting the support of the [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. Relying on their recently procured [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]] to disguise their identities, Skywalker and Solo "escorted" Chewbacca to detention block AA-23.

The ruse seemed to work until they arrived at the detention block. After the three of them stepped out of the [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]], they were immediately asked where they were taking Chewbacca by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Shann Childsen/Legends|Shann Childsen]]. Skywalker told Childsen that he and Han were transferring Chewbacca from [[Cell Block 1138/Legends|Cell Block 1138]] to Detention Block AA-23. As Childsen contacted his superiors, Skywalker and Solo pretended that Chewbacca was breaking free of his handcuffs and handed him a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]].

The resulting firefight claimed the lives of Lieutenant Childsen, [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Prescott]], and [[Devin Cant]], as well as the destruction of the detention block's [[57C holocam|surveillance equipment]]. Before he died, however, Childsen activated an alarm switch, alerting the Death Star's security staff to the fact that there was an emergency situation in Detention Block AA-23. All areas aboard the Death Star were alerted.

[[File:Escape_attempt-TCG-Henning-Ludvigsen.jpg|thumb|right|210px|Han Solo and Chewbacca firing in Detention Block AA 23's cell bay]]
After Skywalker freed the Princess, they discovered that there was only one way out of the detention block, and [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] were coming from that direction. After procuring a blaster rifle from one of her "rescuers," she blasted a hole through a grate into a garbage chute leading to [[Garbage Compactor 3263827]]. Chewbacca, Skywalker, and Solo reluctantly followed.

The [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] prisoner [[VAB-927]] was also held in Detention Block AA-23 on one occasion.<ref name="Quick Locations">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030814web|text=Quick Locations}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Detention Block AA-23 appeared in the first ''[[Star Wars]]'' film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. AA-23 has been referenced several times in the ''Star Wars'' [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]], including shuttle [[AA-23]] in ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''.
